summary: Existing overdraft customers at Demo Bank can apply for an overdraft limit increase directly via the mobile app. The requested limit is capped at a maximum of three times the customer's monthly salary and is evaluated by the system. If approved, the increased limit takes effect immediately; if declined, the customer retains their existing overdraft limit without alteration.

business_rules.rule: Only existing Demo Bank customers who currently hold an active overdraft facility are eligible to request an overdraft limit increase via the mobile app.
business_rules.source_quote: Customers who already have an overdraft at Demo Bank should be able to request a higher limit from the mobile app.

business_rules.rule: The maximum new overdraft limit that can be requested or granted is three times (3x) the customer's monthly salary.
business_rules.source_quote: The new limit can be up to 3 times the monthly salary.

business_rules.rule: Upon system approval of the limit increase request, the new overdraft limit must become active immediately in core banking systems and mobile channels.
business_rules.source_quote: The system checks the request and, if approved, the new limit is active immediately.

business_rules.rule: If the limit increase request is rejected by the system, the customer's current overdraft limit must remain unchanged.
business_rules.source_quote: If the request is not approved, the customer keeps the current limit.

open_questions.question: How is the 'monthly salary' determined and verified (e.g., average of last 3 months direct salary credits into Demo Bank account, open banking data, or customer self-declaration)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without an objective calculation rule, the 3x limit cap cannot be reliably enforced or automated.

open_questions.question: What specific criteria constitute the automated system evaluation (e.g., internal risk score, external credit bureau check, DTI ratio, account delinquency history)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The development team cannot build underwriting logic without explicit decision rules and scoring thresholds.

open_questions.question: Is explicit customer consent required prior to pulling external credit bureau data, and does the journey require electronic signing of an updated credit agreement before activation?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Failing to obtain statutory credit consent and signed credit agreements exposes the bank to regulatory penalties under consumer lending laws.

open_questions.question: What are the absolute minimum and maximum overdraft limits permitted in currency terms regardless of monthly salary?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A high earner could qualify for an unreasonably high unsecured overdraft limit without a hard currency ceiling, or micro-increases could be submitted causing unnecessary operational load.

open_questions.question: What specific feedback or adverse action notification is shown to the customer when a limit increase request is rejected?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Regulatory transparency guidelines require clear communication of decline reasons or next steps, and clear UX prevents repeated failed re-submissions.

open_questions.question: How should the mobile app handle system timeouts or third-party service failures during the real-time check?
open_questions.why_it_matters: An unhandled timeout could leave the customer with an ambiguous status or cause orphaned requests.

open_questions.question: Is there a cooldown period enforced after a rejected request before the customer can apply again?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without a cooldown period, customers could spam the credit decision engine, racking up third-party credit check costs.

risks.description: Increasing credit limits without verifying external debt obligations or obtaining legally required customer consent risks non-compliance with responsible lending regulations.
Over-reliance on unverified salary inputs could lead to overindebtedness and elevated default rates.
Compromised mobile banking credentials could allow fraudsters to immediately increase overdraft limits and cash out funds.
Latency or downtime in core banking or credit scoring services during synchronous processing could stall the immediate activation workflow.
Inaccurate or stale income data in internal core systems could lead to incorrect cap calculations (exceeding or falling below 3x true monthly income).
Customer support overhead may spike if customers receive opaque rejections without actionable explanations.

stories.as_a: mobile banking customer with an existing overdraft
stories.i_want: to request a higher overdraft limit up to 3 times my monthly salary through the mobile app
stories.so_that: I can access additional short-term liquidity when needed
stories.source_quote: Customers who already have an overdraft at Demo Bank should be able to request a higher limit from the mobile app. The new limit can be up to 3 times the monthly salary.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer has an active overdraft facility and opens the overdraft management screen in the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer navigates to the limit increase option
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays the customer's current limit and allows input of a requested limit up to 3 times the monthly salary (defined per [Q-1]) within currency bounds defined per [Q-4].

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer is specifying a new overdraft limit
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer enters an amount greater than 3 times their monthly salary (defined per [Q-1])
acceptance_criteria.then: the mobile app prevents submission and displays an error explaining the maximum permissible limit is 3 times their monthly salary.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer does not hold an existing overdraft facility with Demo Bank
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer accesses the overdraft section in the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.then: the option to request an overdraft limit increase is not available.

stories.as_a: mobile banking customer requesting a limit increase
stories.i_want: the system to evaluate my request immediately
stories.so_that: my approved new overdraft limit becomes available for immediate use
stories.source_quote: The system checks the request and, if approved, the new limit is active immediately.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer submits a valid limit increase request
acceptance_criteria.when: the system completes the automated credit evaluation (defined per [Q-2]) and approves the request
acceptance_criteria.then: the core banking system immediately updates the overdraft limit to the requested amount and the updated limit is immediately visible in the mobile app.

acceptance_criteria.when: the customer initiates a transaction utilizing the newly approved limit right after approval
acceptance_criteria.then: the transaction succeeds up to the new total limit without delay.

stories.as_a: mobile banking customer whose limit increase request is rejected
stories.i_want: my existing overdraft facility to remain intact
stories.so_that: my ongoing borrowing arrangements and daily financial commitments are not disrupted
stories.source_quote: If the request is not approved, the customer keeps the current limit.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer submits a limit increase request
acceptance_criteria.when: the system evaluation (defined per [Q-2]) results in a decline
acceptance_criteria.then: the customer's overdraft limit remains unchanged at the existing amount in core banking and on the mobile app.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system declines the limit increase request
acceptance_criteria.when: the outcome is presented to the customer
acceptance_criteria.then: the mobile app displays a rejection message (defined per [Q-5]) and confirms that their existing limit remains active and available.

uat_cases.title: Display overdraft increase option for eligible existing overdraft holder
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has an active current account with an existing overdraft limit of EUR 1,000 and verified monthly salary of EUR 3,000 (per [Q-1]).
steps: Log in to Demo Bank mobile app.
Navigate to Current Account > Overdraft Details.
uat_cases.expected_result: Current limit of EUR 1,000 is shown and input allows a requested limit up to EUR 9,000 (3x salary).

uat_cases.title: Validate entry at exact 3x monthly salary boundary
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has an existing overdraft of EUR 500 and monthly salary calculated at EUR 2,500.
uat_cases.expected_result: System accepts the input without validation errors and proceeds to submission/confirmation.

uat_cases.title: Reject requested limit exceeding 3x monthly salary boundary
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has an existing overdraft of EUR 500 and monthly salary calculated at EUR 2,500.
uat_cases.expected_result: App blocks submission and displays an error indicating maximum allowable limit is EUR 7,500.

uat_cases.title: Hide or disable limit increase option for customer without an existing overdraft
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has a standard current account with no overdraft limit attached.
steps: Log in to Demo Bank mobile app.
uat_cases.expected_result: No option to request an overdraft 'increase' is displayed (only new product application or no overdraft options shown).

uat_cases.title: Approve limit increase and verify immediate limit activation
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has EUR 1,000 overdraft limit, salary EUR 3,000, and meets all underwriting criteria for an increase to EUR 3,000.
steps: Check account balance/limit overview in mobile app.
Execute a debit transaction drawing down EUR 2,500 into overdraft.
uat_cases.expected_result: Approval confirmation is displayed, mobile app immediately reflects EUR 3,000 limit, and the EUR 2,500 transaction succeeds immediately.

uat_cases.title: Handle system rejection and ensure existing limit is preserved
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has EUR 1,000 overdraft limit and fails automated system risk evaluation (e.g. poor internal repayment score per [Q-2]).
steps: Navigate back to Current Account overview and check available overdraft limit.
uat_cases.expected_result: Request is declined with clear rejection feedback per [Q-5], and the overdraft limit remains EUR 1,000 with no change.
